prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic cozy bedroom selfie of an approved adult woman.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long voluminous dark-brown hair spread across a light pillow, natural glowing skin, soft eye makeup, glossy lips, and playful closed-mouth smile, wearing a fitted opaque dark-grey top and delicate cross pendant.
prompt.composition_elements: Top-down handheld smartphone selfie, close-up with upper torso, one arm holding the phone near the top edge, hair across neutral bedding and pillow, centered slight tilt.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural diffused window light, even face illumination, soft highlights and minimal shadows, relaxed cozy social-media mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 4K-style photorealistic smartphone front camera, 24–28mm equivalent, f/2.0, ISO 100, 1/60s, sharp face with slight edge falloff.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: An ultra-realistic top-down smartphone selfie of an approved adult woman lying comfortably on a bed, holding the phone above her. She has long voluminous dark-brown hair spread naturally across a light pillow, smooth realistic skin with natural glow, subtle eye makeup, and glossy lips with a playful closed-mouth smile. She wears a fitted opaque dark-grey top and a delicate necklace with a small cross pendant. One arm enters the upper frame holding the phone. Use neutral white or cream bedding, natural diffused window light, soft highlights, minimal shadows, 24–28mm front-camera perspective, 4K-style detail, realistic color, and relaxed cozy social-media mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, tongue out, flirty sexualized expression, lingerie, exposed chest, sexualized lying pose, nudity, blurry, low resolution, harsh shadows, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, watermark, text, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

assets.name: innocent-sultry-playful-selfie_0.jpg
assets.usage: Bed, pillow, hair spread, dark top, phone arm, window light, and top-down composition reference.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required environment reference. Preserve approved-adult identity, hair, bedding, top, cross pendant, phone placement, and light; replace identity or wardrobe with approved equivalents. Keep pose comfortable and typography absent.

changes: Clarified approved adult and replaced tongue-out/flirty sexualized expression with a playful closed-mouth smile; retained the cozy top-down selfie concept.
